speaker: thomas_pope
text: Five Worthies and four of us to show them, John. If I am Hector and Pompey does not clear the door, we shall have two ancients wedged in one arras.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Costard clears by the south post, Tom, and you come down the middle with the target. Keep your voice out toward the yard.

speaker: george_bryan
text: And when Alexander is put out of countenance, Will, do I step back to the hangings at once, or wait?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Stay two paces inside the pillars, George, so they have to look past an honest man who has missed his line.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: A man who misses his line in front of a full yard has no need of pillars to feel small.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It wants ten minutes of eleven, Will. If you mean to be at Paul's before the stalls thicken, go now. We can run the pedant's exit without Navarre.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep Sam out of the wind while you wait, John. This east air dries a boy's throat.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Augustine has his cloak round him behind the tire-house door. Go on to your book-board.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Bring us no more Latin tags from the churchyard, Will. My tongue has scarce forgiven Friday's.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Only English today, George, and none of it for your roll.
